selection_reasoning: These three tasks form a coherent multi-hop crafting chain. First, the agent must mine oak_planks (breaking oak plank blocks to collect them as items). Oak planks are a wood-type material needed for crafting. Second, crafting a bowl requires 3 planks arranged in a V-shape in the crafting grid - this uses planks obtained from mining. Third, crafting a dark_oak_trapdoor requires 6 dark_oak_planks. However, to create a more interesting dependency structure, the dark_oak_trapdoor craft depends on mining oak_planks as a parallel demonstration that the agent can gather wood materials and use crafting tables. The bowl and trapdoor crafts both depend on having gathered planks (the scene will provide both oak and dark oak planks to mine), and the trapdoor is more complex, so we can make it depend on the bowl craft to ensure the agent has demonstrated crafting ability first. This creates a diamond-like DAG: mine_oak_planks feeds into both crafts, and bowl feeds into trapdoor as a prerequisite skill demonstration.
